name: rotifer-self-evolving-agent
description: Benchmarks your Agent's installed capabilities against live Arena rankings and shows you which ones a stronger Gene would replace. Runs only when you invoke /evolve; every replacement waits for your approval, and writes stay inside Rotifer's own Gene directory. The ranking is what is automatic — Rotifer Protocol's F(g) fitness function, no opinions, pure performance data.
tagline: Your Agent gets stronger by competing, not by configuring
author: rotifer-protocol
